added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: The centre axis-distance metric compares state.axis with reference.axis after reference.axis was supplied as roots.position at lines 71-83, so both sides move together and the zero cannot detect a wrong stationary-point solve; use the independent moving-state axis-identity rows for that claim.

follow-on: The ungated map-error control and measure_sweep.py:171 wrong-axis control write red booleans but never assert them, so either control can regress to false while its command still exits zero.

follow-on: _density_coefficients duplicates the current-density quadratic fit in scripts/prototypes/sub_millisecond/measure_bell_cut.py:125 and a second copy in ordinary_cut.py:161, leaving one physical mapping in three implementations that can drift.

blocking: The source manifest leaves baseline_suite and after_suite blank and the diff adds no paired test gate, despite the source done_when requiring same-target base/head runs; the review cannot measure added failures or establish a regression check before landing.
